lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
A dozen First Nations are being provided a loan guarantee to support their investment in a pipeline feeding natural gas to the LNG Canada plant, The Canadian Press reports.
Mexico seeks a meeting with U.S. aviation authorities to discuss permits for SpaceX to use Mexican airspace, Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said.
Two Italians killed by ‘drone strike debris’ in Kuwait, Al Jazeera reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
